sql_reading_A.note: the phone filter applies to the students averaged
sql_reading_A.sql: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.OFFICE_PHONE) FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s WHERE s.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND s.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(s.OFFICE_PHONE) DESC LIMIT 5

sql_reading_B.note: the phone filter selects the departments considered
sql_reading_B.sql: SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.OFFICE_PHONE) FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s WHERE s.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT DISTINCT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t WHERE t.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(s.OFFICE_PHONE) DESC LIMIT 5
